notes.title: Big Features Update
notes.content:
Update notes:

[b]Community Feedback Integration[/b]: Numerous suggestions and requests from our dedicated player community have been carefully reviewed and implemented. This update has been shaped by the invaluable feedback received from you!

[b]New Game Mechanic[/b]: Introducing an exciting addition to the gameplay experience! There is now a special element present on each level that changes on how player engages the enemies (no spoilers!).

IMPORTANT: because of this big game mechanic change all previous game progress will be reset automatically

[b]Timed level game play[/b]: Earn medals based on how quickly player clears a level.

[b]Player's Spaceship visible damage[/b]: Spaceships now has visible damage on on hull when damaged.

[b]New enemy types[/b]: Several new enemy types that challenge the player in different ways.

[b]UI improvements[/b]: Additional elements on screen that help player's awareness.

[b]Game balancing[/b]: ALL levels are reworked and balanced according to new game mechanic.

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]: The importance of enhancing your overall experience is very well understood. In this update, the focus has been on addressing quality of life issues to make your gameplay more seamless and enjoyable.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]: This update brings stability and reliability to the game, ensuring a smoother and more immersive experience. From minor visual inconsistencies to more significant issues, all of them have been diligently worked on to be resolved.

Your feedback on these changes is eagerly anticipated, and the game will continue to evolve based on your valuable input.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and new content in the near future!
